description: Lists PushEngage sites the authenticated user can access. Returns site_id, site_name, site_url, and site_status. Also returns current_site_id so the assistant can see which site is already active without calling pushengage_auth_status. When the user asks to send a notification linking to their site's homepage, use site_url as the notification's url field.
name: pushengage_list_sites
title: List sites
